_doc: Scene timings and text. {x} = a value read from the page at run time (video/raw/values.json). Text inside [[ ]] is dropped when any placeholder in it is unavailable. Narration time = words / 2.5 + 0.6 s; scene duration = max(action time, narration time, min_hold_s).

scenes.title: Intro
scenes.narration: This is ChainBreaker, an AI agent built on FalkorDB for Graph Hacks.

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.caption: March 2025 · one leaked token → 23,000+ repos
scenes.narration: In March 2025, one leaked token moved through a chain of GitHub Actions and compromised tj-actions/changed-files, an action used by more than twenty-three thousand repositories. Every team asked the same question: are we affected?

scenes.title: Compromise
scenes.caption: Grep finds {depth1} pipelines
scenes.narration: Here's a demo org with {pipelines} pipelines. Say one action, cb-changed-files, just got compromised. Search our workflow files for it, like grep would, and you find {depth1} pipelines.

scenes.title: Depth
scenes.caption: The graph finds {total} · {hidden} hidden
scenes.narration: But actions use other actions. Follow the chain four hops deep in the graph, and it's {total}. {hidden} of them never mention the hacked action at all.

scenes.title: Path
caption: Every answer comes with its path
Pinned to a commit, still exposed
scenes.narration: Every result comes with its path, with the file and line for each hop. And mobile-app pinned to an exact commit, and it's still exposed, because the pinned code pulls the bad tag inside.

scenes.title: Agent
scenes.caption: Fixed FalkorDB tools · no LLM-written queries
scenes.narration: You can also just ask. The agent never writes database queries. It picks from fixed FalkorDB tools, shows the path behind its answer, and every name is checked against the graph.

scenes.title: Not in graph
scenes.caption: Not in the graph → it says so
scenes.narration: Ask about something that isn't there, and it says so instead of guessing.

narration.maxflow: Now the fix. Instead of patching {protected} pipelines one by one, ChainBreaker treats it as a min-cut and runs FalkorDB's max-flow algorithm. {changes} line changes protect all {protected}, and it proves it on a copy of the graph first.
narration.fallback: Now the fix. Instead of patching {protected} pipelines one by one, ChainBreaker treats it as a min-cut and computes the cut over the graph FalkorDB serves. {changes} line changes protect all {protected}, and it proves it on a copy of the graph first.

scenes.title: PRs
scenes.caption: Real PRs in the demo org
scenes.narration: Then it acts. These are real pull requests, pinning the bad action to a known-good commit, including one line inside a shared action.

scenes.title: Rescan
scenes.caption: Rescan: {total_after} exposed
scenes.narration: Merge, move the tag, re-pin mobile-app, rescan… and nothing is exposed.

scenes.title: Scale
scenes.caption: {cncf_repos} real CNCF repos[[ · {hidden_pct} hidden from grep]]
scenes.narration: And it's not a toy. Here it is on {cncf_repos} real CNCF repositories. [[{hidden_pct} of exposure is invisible to grep, and ]]these are the actions the ecosystem leans on most.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.narration: ChainBreaker. The graph finds what grep can't, and fixes it in the fewest moves.
